_policy.summary: Central register for every photograph on the site. Credits are NEVER rendered in the public UI; this file is the audit trail.
_policy.source: Wikimedia Commons only (licence metadata is machine-readable and per-file). Unsplash, Pexels and Pixabay were not used: they block automated access and their per-photo licence pages could not be opened and recorded.
rejected: Any Creative Commons licence needing attribution (BY, BY-SA) – credits may not be shown in the UI
Watermarked images (e.g. the Karting-Reel / Léon Delorme series has the credit baked into the pixels)
Files with Commons usage restrictions or non-free flags
Images with camera date stamps or readable third-party advertising banners
verificationProcess: scripts/fetch-images.mjs queries the Commons API licence record (LicenseShortName, Restrictions, NonFree, AttributionRequired) for each file.
It then downloads the public file description page and confirms the CC0 / public-domain statement is actually present on it.
Only on success are 480/960/1920px renditions downloaded and status set to "verified"; otherwise "rejected".
Thumbnails were reviewed by eye for watermarks, date stamps and legible advertising before any file was assigned.
scripts/build-pages.mjs refuses to build if a referenced image is not "verified" or is used more than once.
